hooks.prompt: Open Brain context check: if this user request depends on previous decisions, project-specific conventions, people, documents, or unfamiliar local history, search Open Brain before acting. Use search_brain for broad recall and narrower Open Brain search tools when the target person, project, or document type is clear. Skip recall for small mechanical edits or tasks whose required context is fully available in the current conversation and repository.

Open Brain capture reminder: the session is ending. Silently review the completed work and call capture_thought for durable facts likely to matter later: decisions and reasons, non-obvious fixes, stable project constraints, user preferences, milestones, or named follow-ups. Do not capture raw transcripts, command output, routine progress, obvious duplicates, or unvalidated guesses. Prefer one concise, self-contained capture per durable item, with tags/projects/people metadata when clear. Do not address the user unless capture fails in a way they need to know about.
